summary: New-customer signup and KYC is failing because auth-kyc cannot open TCP connections to the external kyc-provider. The first error is at 09:55:40Z, matching the reported onset of about 09:55, and the errors continue through at least 10:15. auth-kyc's error rate peaked at 0.604 while its request rate stayed flat, so the cause is not a traffic change. The only change in the window is a postgres deploy at 09:13 (metrics label rename), which is 42 minutes before onset and unrelated to the logged error. I could not tell whether the vendor is down or whether auth-kyc's egress path to it is broken, because there is no topology link or health data for kyc-provider.

hypotheses.statement: The external KYC vendor endpoint (kyc-provider) is down or refusing connections, so auth-kyc KYC calls fail and signup cannot complete.
hypotheses.label: low

supporting.text: First auth-kyc error in the window is a refused connection to the KYC vendor, at the incident onset
The same error is still occurring 20 minutes later, so the failure is persistent
auth-kyc error rate rose to about 60% and was still there at the end of the window

hypotheses.statement: A network, egress or endpoint-configuration problem on the auth-kyc side (for example firewall, DNS or IP change) is blocking connections to a healthy kyc-provider.
hypotheses.label: low

unresolved: Whether kyc-provider is actually down or whether auth-kyc's egress path to it is broken (H1 vs H2); no vendor health data or topology link was available.
Why the error rate is only about 0.6 rather than near 1.0, and which requests succeed.
The log query was truncated (37 matches, 30 returned); the 10:15-10:20 tail was not reviewed, though err_rate still reads 0.603 at the end.
Whether other auth-kyc errors besides vendor connection refusals exist; the log search was not broken down by message.
Whether orchestrator or wa-webhook show any independent problem; they were not queried.

actions.text: Check kyc-provider's status page and contact the vendor to confirm whether it has an outage or has changed or blocked access since about 09:55 UTC.
actions.rationale: Logs show TCP connection refused to kyc-provider starting at onset, and the error is still occurring at 10:15.

actions.text: From an auth-kyc host, test DNS resolution and TCP connectivity to the kyc-provider endpoint, and review egress/firewall and endpoint config changes made outside the change feed.
actions.rationale: This separates a vendor outage (H1) from an auth-kyc-side network or config fault (H2). The change feed shows no auth-kyc changes, so any such change would be outside it.

actions.text: If the vendor is confirmed down, enable a fallback or queue-and-retry for KYC submissions and show customers a clear 'verification delayed' message.
actions.rationale: The error rate is about 60% and persistent, so new customers are blocked until the vendor path recovers.

actions.text: Add kyc-provider as a modeled dependency of auth-kyc, with a health probe and an alert on vendor connection errors.
actions.rationale: The topology showed only the caller orchestrator and no vendor link, which hid the real dependency.

actions.text: No rollback of the postgres 09:13 deploy is needed on current evidence. Re-check only if the vendor path proves healthy.
